title: Balloting and Placement Data for 2025 Secondary School Posting Exercise
what_it_is: Balloting and Placement Data for 2025 Secondary School Posting Exercise

sections.label: Secondary 1 posting tie-breakers
sections.summary: MOE applies tie-breakers in order of citizenship, school choice ranking and computerised balloting, and tracks top-choice placement rates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Under the Achievement Levels (AL) scoring system, more students will have identical scores.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: When two or more students have identical scores and are competing for the last available vacancy at a school, the Ministry of Education (MOE) applies tie-breakers in the following order: the student's citizenship status, then the student's ranking of that school in their choices and finally, computerised balloting if needed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: In the 2025 Secondary 1 Posting Exercise, around one in 10 students underwent computerised balloting.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: MOE does not track the number of students who were not successful despite meeting the cut-off point for a school, as this number can vary widely for individual schools each year, depending on students' choice.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Instead, MOE tracks the percentage of students who were placed in a school amongst their top six choices.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Since 2021, more than eight in 10 students were posted to a school within one of their top three choices, and more than nine in 10 to a school within their six choices.

sections.label: Balloting rate variation factors
sections.summary: Balloting rates vary yearly depending on school choices, students' decisions and DSA numbers, and the Ministry will study suggestions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: It varies, could be varied by one to two points, depends on each year's exercise.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, in a way, each school's balloting rate depends ultimately on school choices and students' decisions, and DSA numbers and the kinds of students and numbers of students they admit each year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Having said that, it is linked to the Member's second point, and the Ministry will certainly study all of these suggestions and more.
